items.q: Beotimmok or the youth product: which is better?
items.a: If you are 34 or younger, usually the youth product: its ₩150M limit exceeds Beotimmok's ₩120M (Seoul metro) and it lends up to 80% of the deposit.

items.q: How is the ₩345M net-asset cap calculated?
items.a: Assets of you and your spouse minus debts. The cap follows Statistics Korea's household survey and is ₩345M for 2026.

items.q: Does the loan renew with the lease?
items.a: No, it needs an extension review. Fund jeonse loans run in 2-year terms up to 10 years (12 for the newborn product), plus 2 years per minor child.

items.q: How much is the deposit guarantee fee?
items.a: HUG fee = deposit × fee rate (0.097–0.211% p.a.) × lease term, with 60% off for income up to ₩50M. For a ₩200M non-apartment deposit over 2 years that is about ₩190K at a debt ratio up to 70%, or about ₩240K up to 80%.

overview.title: Key conditions by product
items: Beotimmok: income ≤ ₩50M (2 children ₩60M, newlywed ₩75M), net assets ≤ ₩345M, deposit ≤ ₩300M metro / ₩200M elsewhere, limit ₩120M / ₩80M (70% of deposit)
Youth: age 19–34, deposit ≤ ₩300M, limit ₩150M (₩120M for single under 25), 80% of deposit
Newlywed: married ≤ 7 years, income ≤ ₩75M, deposit ≤ ₩400M / ₩300M, limit ₩250M / ₩160M
Newborn special: birth within 2 years, income ≤ ₩130M (dual ₩200M), deposit ≤ ₩500M / ₩400M, limit ₩240M
Commercial bank: no income cap but higher rates; HF guarantee basis 80% of deposit up to ₩400M

rates.title: How the rate is set
items: Base rate comes from the combined income bracket and deposit bracket (variable, set by MOLIT).
Homes outside the Seoul metro area get 0.2%p off.
Discounts: children (0.3/0.5/0.7%p), youth SME 0.3%p, e-contract 0.1%p, borrowing ≤ 30% of limit 0.2%p.
Total discount is capped at 0.5%p (0.7%p for 3+ children) and the final rate never goes below 1.0%.

tips.title: Good to know
items: Apply within 3 months of the earlier of balance payment or move-in date.
Borrowing ≤ 30% of your limit earns a 0.2%p discount.
HUG's jeonse loan guarantee includes deposit return protection; with an HF guarantee, buy it separately.
When comparing with monthly rent, also consider the opportunity cost of your own cash.

whatIs.title: What is the Jeonse Loan Calculator?
whatIs.description: The Jeonse Loan Calculator automatically computes interest rates, loan limits, and monthly interest for Korean jeonse (deposit-based rental) loans based on 2025 guidelines. Compare products from Bokeummok (government), internet banks (Kakao, K-Bank), and commercial banks to see your actual interest burden before signing a jeonse contract.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: 1. Enter the jeonse deposit amount and desired loan amount.
2. Select the loan product type (Bokeummok, commercial bank, internet bank) and rate type (fixed/variable).
3. Choose the loan term (in 2-year increments) and repayment method.
4. Review the monthly interest payment, total interest, and loan limit range.

items.q: Are jeonse loans subject to DSR regulation?
items.a: Jeonse loans count only their interest portion in DSR calculation (not principal), making them carry less DSR burden than mortgages—generally easier to obtain within limits.

items.q: Is the loan automatically renewed when the jeonse contract renews?
items.a: No. You must apply for a separate loan extension review 1–2 months before the loan matures. The bank will re-evaluate your income and credit.

items.q: How do I protect against 'empty jeonse' (깡통전세) risk?
items.a: If the jeonse-to-sale-price ratio exceeds 80%, risk is high. Jeonse deposit insurance is essential, along with checking the property registry for prior liens.
